stats.fact: Metorial (YC F25) has 3,316 GitHub stars on its main repo and supports 1,200+ integrations
There are over 130,000 MCP-related repositories on GitHub, with awesome-mcp-servers at 90,851 stars
62% of organizations are already experimenting with AI agents
95% of AI agent projects fail to deliver production value
Over 15% of employees are running MCP servers locally, with 86% granting them full privileges and storing credentials in plaintext
Composio, the main competitor, has 29,254 GitHub stars and was founded in February 2024
Metorial Platform (open-source engine) has 217 GitHub stars, powering hundreds of thousands of MCP connections
Metorial offers three pricing tiers: Dev (free), Scale ($250/month), and Enterprise (custom)

angles: Metorial as 'Vercel for MCP' — the deployment and scaling layer for AI agent infrastructure, analogous to how Vercel simplified web deployment
Open-source advantage — Metorial Platform is self-hostable, unlike Composio's closed-source core, giving enterprises control over their agent infrastructure
Security-first approach with Protoguard — real-time prompt injection detection, tool-scope enforcement, and PII leakage prevention as a differentiator
The 'Magic MCP' concept — a single URL connecting any AI agent to every approved tool, eliminating the integration fragmentation problem
YC-backed legitimacy — Y Combinator F25 batch signals institutional confidence in the MCP infrastructure market
Enterprise governance features — SSO/SAML/SCIM, RBAC, audit logs, and KMS key management make it suitable for regulated industries
The MCP hosting market is still nascent — Metorial is early but well-positioned as organizations move from experimentation to production
